purpose.description: Your CSS and HTML implement the required visual rules to style the Olivia Woodruff portfolio page with a CornflowerBlue header, centered text, larger about-me text at 20px, 50% opacity, bold section titles, Azure headings, Georgia font, and a hypnotic background as instructed.
Code runs without syntax errors and aligns with the project tasks listed (Task 1-8 implemented).

readability.description: Variables and selectors are named clearly (e.g., .header, .about-me, .title).
Code is straightforward and easy to follow; consider adding comments for future maintenance (e.g., explain why opacity is set or why Azure is chosen).

performance.description: Styles apply efficiently with a small, flat CSS file; no unnecessary selectors present.
Consider ensuring accessibility: contrast between .about-me text and background remains readable; if needed, adjust color or opacity to maintain legibility.
